title: サイレンススズカ、覚醒④

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's October. Taiki Shuttle goes wild along with the crowd as the top Umamusume on the scene sprints full speed ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Otherworldly Front-Runner, Silence Suzuka, takes the glory with her daring runaway style!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fully captivated by her performance, a swarm of fans gather near the winner's circle to celebrate her victory.
